name: Mitchelle Moore
source:
Since she was young, Mitts has had a thirst for knowledge and to bring change in the field of technology.

She can build just about anything if she sets her mind to it...

Though, she's going to need an extra hand if she wants to get to Utopia and accomplish her goals.
